title: AERO9500 Report Marking Rubric (Assignment Part 2)

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Addresses all requirements to a high standard. Detailed descriptions and discussions included. References to literature as appropriate.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Addresses some requirements. Descriptions may lack specific details and/or incomplete referencing.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Many or all requirements not addressed. Poor descriptions or lack of appropriate referencing.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Demonstrates high-level understanding of design procedure. Design clearly addresses mission and course concepts. All major requirements addressed and well-supported with quality evidence (screenshots, software files, hand calculations, literature). Content comprehensive, accurate, and persuasive.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Demonstrates adequate understanding of design procedure. Design maybe inconsistent regarding purpose and clarity or features errors. Major requirements addressed but may lack detail or evidence. Content may not be comprehensive or persuasive.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Demonstrates minimal understanding of design procedure. Major requirements not addressed and/or lack evidence. Content incomplete or not persuasive.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Detailed and appropriate conclusions reached from the evidence provided in the report.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Some conclusions reached but generic or lacking specific detail.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: No actual or useful conclusions reached.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.desc: Follows clear and logical engineering report structure. Easy to read, well-written, good spelling/grammar, appropriate style. Consistent formatting. Executive summary/abstract provides concise overview. Graphical/tabular data appropriate, clear, consistent. In-text references match reference list and properly cited.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.desc: Not professional level but uses headings/subheadings. Report may be difficult to read: writing just ok, broad idea clear, spelling/grammar flaws, somewhat inappropriate style. Figures/tables labelled but formatting unclear/inconsistent causing loss of context. References mostly match list and mostly correctly cited.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.desc: Poorly structured, not coherent, shows lack of understanding of section purpose. Requires much effort to read: poor writing, many spelling/grammar mistakes, possibly inappropriate informal style. Presentation impedes reading. Inconsistent formatting, unlabelled figures/tables. References not cited or inconsistently cited.

notes: 25% of course grade. Criteria: Introduction must include spacecraft primary mission, why needed, number of spacecraft and why, users (operator and customers). Main body must include summary using software/hand calculations, screenshots and software files, launch site and vehicle with justification, orbit type/characteristics/elements, orbital maneuvers, ground control facilities, communication frequency, mission duration and EOL plans.
